**Screen-Space Noise:** Sampling noise using screen UVs (`uv`) pins the noise pattern to the screen, causing it to "swim" as the camera moves.
**Interpolation Halos:** Trilinear interpolation can cause a sampling point near the edge of an empty block to map to a non-zero opacity if a neighboring block is occupied.
